name: utm-to-geojson-no-position
source: synthetic: built by hand from the field numbers in packs/sapient/pack.def (7 DetectionReport, 7.2 object_id, 7.6 Location: 1 x, 2 y, 3 z as doubles, 7 coordinate_system, 8 datum as varints); object_id is the example ULID of the ULID specification; doubles are little-endian IEEE-754 of the decimal text; the input of 04-utm-roundtrip-other-system
reference: Decoded as detection_report_other_system (see 04), so the entity has no lat or lon: the geojson geometry is null (ruling 5 of 0.1.1). uid is derived from the object id (model/sapient.def, 0.6) and written at id (ruling 4 of 0.1.1); properties is {}.
